constraints.constraint: high uncertainty is not reducible uncertainty; a mechanism must discriminate reducible from irreducible error, not fire on raw uncertainty
source-specific reducibility does not imply cross-source value; a value signal must transfer across sources before confirmation
learned retrieval must beat nearest-similarity by SESOI, not merely perform a successful nearest-neighbour lookup
relational event boundaries must beat simple change detectors in downstream value, not merely segment the stream
a stable trace must beat EMA smoothing and matched-memory buffers in downstream value
affordance reading must beat a fitted value estimator on the same latent
learned rollouts must control compounding model error and beat direct prediction and simple planning after charging model-error estimation
message predictability is not causal message value; a messaging mechanism must estimate intervention-level value and beat a centralized matched-capacity control
contradiction detection is not repair necessity; a repair mechanism must estimate net corrected-decision value and avoid false-repair harm
per-item value prediction is not sufficient for a competitive replay policy; a replay mechanism must beat the best established method (GDumb), not only no-replay
incremental value must hold across a family of sufficiently capable architectures, not a single one, to be admitted
every mechanism must clear noisy-TV, shuffled-target, wrong-time, and rate-matched-random controls, and provide oracle headroom, before a canary

usage: these become mandatory admission clauses for every future mechanism.
